groups.rationale: Pins: buildNixpkgs follows devenv-nixpkgs/rolling pinned by flake.lock, the package-input-lock check enforces equality with devenv.lock, automatic nix upgrades syncs both, and flake.lock is HLDD-exempt like devenv.lock. Docs and ADR-0039 name the grouped nixosModules paths. Behaviour, chapters, domains and topology are unchanged.

devenv gives each linked git worktree its own hooks directory (per-worktree core.hooksPath) before git-hooks install, so concurrent worktrees stop rewriting the shared pre-commit hook to another worktree config; developer tooling only.
